# Audio fixtures

`LANDR-Walkin' In That Rundown Town-Warm-Medium-REV_V1.wav` is a committed
real-audio fixture for automated tests. It intentionally lives under
`tests/fixtures/audio/` so it is not treated as a Studio project upload or user
project asset.

Keep tests that use this file bounded with short analysis durations unless the
test is specifically validating long-form behavior.
